whatsNew.en:
Version 5.1

• Enjoy a refreshed adaptive design, refined for clarity in Light and Dark.
• Choose Automatic, Light, or Dark independently inside SShift.
• Move faster through Dashboard ranges, day edits, schedule patterns, and reminders.
• Reliability improvements for backup and restore, PDF export, duplicate-day handling, and notifications.
whatsNew.ar:
الإصدار 5.1

• تصميم متجدد ومتكيّف، أوضح وأجمل في المظهرين الفاتح والداكن.
• اختر المظهر التلقائي أو الفاتح أو الداكن من داخل SShift بشكل مستقل عن مظهر الجهاز.
• استجابة أسرع في نطاقات اللوحة وتعديل الأيام وأنماط الجدول والتنبيهات.
• تحسينات في موثوقية النسخ الاحتياطي والاستعادة وتصدير PDF ومعالجة الأيام المكررة والتذكيرات.

whatsNew.en:
Version 5.0

• Add SShift Widgets for your Home Screen and Lock Screen, so you can see today’s shift and the days ahead at a glance.
• Add Academic Leave as a clear, dedicated leave type.
• Refine Calendar navigation and add a custom date range to Dashboard.
• Improve reliability and polish across schedule updates, backup compatibility, and the bilingual experience.
whatsNew.ar:
الإصدار 5.0

• أضفنا أدوات SShift للشاشة الرئيسية وشاشة القفل لعرض وردية اليوم والأيام القادمة بنظرة واحدة.
• أضفنا إجازة دراسية كنوع إجازة واضح ومستقل.
• حسّنا التنقل في التقويم وأضفنا نطاق تاريخ مخصصاً في اللوحة.
• تحسينات في الموثوقية واللمسات النهائية لتحديثات الجدول وتوافق النسخ الاحتياطي والتجربة الثنائية اللغة.

whatsNew.en:
A fresh look for your day.

- The "Today" card on the Calendar has a new design — your day's color now fills the card, so work, rest, and leave days stand out at a glance, with a cleaner layout and a circular type icon.
- Tap the Today card to jump straight into editing today.
- Smoother Dashboard switching and calendar month transitions, plus small visual polish throughout.

Version 4.1.1

• Updated App Store screenshots to better reflect the latest SShift design.

Thank you for using SShift.

Version 4.1

- New "Same day" reminder option — get notified on the day of your shift.

- Per-leave-type notifications — choose exactly which leave types should remind you.

- Clearer Notifications settings — improved permission guidance when iOS notifications are off.

- Smarter notification handling — old reminders are now cleaned up after clearing or restoring schedule data.

- Better first-run experience — new users now see a clear Set Up Schedule card when no schedule exists.

- Improved Backup and Restore feedback — failed backup or restore actions now show a clear message.

- Updated About page with the SShift app logo.

Thank you for using SShift.

Improved Arabic language and right-to-left layout support across the app.
Redesigned PDF export with a clean, always-light printable design.
New per-leave-type breakdown on the Dashboard.
Localization polish, release prep, and stability improvements.

This update includes a refreshed app icon and launch experience, improved dashboard card layout, cleaner Settings icons and spacing, better bottom navigation consistency, plus bug fixes, stability improvements, and overall UI polish.

Version 3.0 brings a major refresh to SShift with a cleaner interface, improved calendar editing, a redesigned dashboard, better settings organization, Arabic support, and a more polished overall experience.

What’s new:
• Redesigned dashboard with cleaner stats and upcoming summaries
• Improved settings layout and better visual organization
• Better About page with a clearer feature overview
• Improved calendar editing for empty days and leave selection
• Better in-app language support for English and Arabic
• Updated visuals across key screens for a cleaner experience
• Improved launch experience and overall polish
• Stability improvements and general fixes
Welcome to SShift 2.0 — a cleaner UI, a clearer calendar, smarter notes, and faster performance. Simpler, smoother, better.

PhoneSpace 1.2.1 improves safety and reliability across Convert and Resize.

• Free limits are now enforced per item, while Premium use no longer spends free allowances.
• Animated GIF inputs are blocked before conversion so motion cannot be lost accidentally.
• Replace Originals now clearly explains which Photos metadata cannot be preserved.
• Resize cancellation responds faster, and deletion results report only confirmed removals.
• Convert Videos now warns that changing file type can sometimes increase size.

This update also improves StoreKit test consistency and keeps all processing private and on device.

Compress is now Resize. Choose the size you want and see the result before you start.

Pick how much smaller, and the new size is right there before you commit. Resize won't promise a size it can't deliver — when a file can't go smaller, it says so and tells you which one is holding the rest back.

Convert is simpler. One screen. Choose a format — that's the whole decision. Videos keep their original quality and resolution instead of being quietly downscaled.

Converting a photo no longer removes its metadata or shrinks it. Photos keep their date, camera and location, stay at full resolution, and are written at very high quality — so converted copies are larger than before. Use Resize to make them smaller.

Removing location and metadata now works on every photo you convert. Before, it only took effect when the photo was also resized, so some conversions kept their location. Turn on "Remove location & metadata" on the Convert screen when you want it gone.

Rescan actually rescans. It used to say "Scanned just now" while returning an older count. Now it re-measures every time, and the button is big enough to hit.

A rebuilt Home. Categories are cards with their sizes lined up in one column, so you can compare at a glance.

This update focuses on accessibility, performance, and reliability:

• Full VoiceOver support — every screen and selectable item is now properly labeled and announced.
• Smoother scrolling through large photo and video libraries, with lower memory use on big collections.
• Safer, more reliable contacts cleanup — clearer confirmations, and delete and merge now keep a recoverable backup before anything is removed.
• Improved reliability when converting and sharing photos and videos.
• Additional stability and performance refinements.

Dufaat 2.2.1 improves reliability without changing how your data is stored.

• Backup restore is now safer and transactional
• Cancelled detail edits no longer change paid dates
• Imported attachments are read more reliably
• Clearer localized attachment error messages
• Temporary preview and export files are cleaned up automatically

• إلغاء تعديلات تفاصيل الدفعة لم يعد يغيّر تاريخ السداد
• قراءة المرفقات المستوردة أصبحت أكثر موثوقية
• رسائل أوضح ومترجمة عند تعذر إرفاق ملف
• تنظيف ملفات المعاينة والتصدير المؤقتة تلقائيًا

whatsNew.en:
Dufaat 2.2 brings a Saudi-first experience and stronger privacy:

• Faster access to SAR and AED when adding payments
• Instant switching between Arabic and English
• App Lock with Face ID, Touch ID, or your device passcode
• Cleaner PDF statements that follow your device calendar
• Redesigned Settings
• New Dufaat Plus: professional PDF Studio, a 30/60/90-day financial outlook, and smart reminders with a one-time purchase
• Reliability and localization improvements
whatsNew.ar:
يقدّم دُفعات 2.2 تجربة أقرب للمستخدم في السعودية وخصوصية أفضل:

• وصول أسرع إلى الريال السعودي والدرهم عند إضافة الدفعات
• تبديل فوري بين العربية والإنجليزية
• قفل التطبيق عبر Face ID أو Touch ID أو رمز دخول الجهاز
• كشوف PDF أوضح تتبع تقويم جهازك
• تصميم جديد للإعدادات
• دُفعات Plus الجديد: استوديو PDF احترافي، نظرة مالية لـ30 و60 و90 يومًا، وتنبيهات ذكية بشراء مرة واحدة
• تحسينات في الموثوقية والترجمة

whatsNew.en:
Pay Soon: for short-term amounts and money you pay off with your monthly salary — completely separate from your long-term installments. Add the amount and its due date, and follow each month at a glance: what's paid, what's still due, and what's overdue.

Improved PDF reports: choose the report period, attach your payment proofs, and combine everything into one tidy file that's ready to share.

Performance improvements and fixes for a smoother, clearer experience.
whatsNew.ar:
قسم "للتسديد": للسلف والمبالغ المؤقتة التي تسدّدها على راتبك — منفصلة تمامًا عن أقساطك طويلة المدى. أضِف المبلغ وتاريخ استحقاقه، وتابع كل شهر بنظرة واحدة: ما دُفع، وما تبقّى، وما تأخّر.

تقارير PDF محسّنة: اختر فترة التقرير، أرفِق إثباتات الدفع، ووحّدها في ملف واحد مرتّب جاهز للمشاركة.

تحسينات في الأداء وإصلاحات لتجربة أسلس وأوضح.

whatsNew.en:
A whole new look

Dufaat is calmer and more beautiful — a warm new visual identity with luminous touches that makes tracking your installments a relaxed experience.

What's new:
- A completely redesigned, warm and refined look in both light and dark mode
- Defer payments: officially postpone any payment — it shows as "Deferred" instead of "Overdue," moves to the end of the schedule, and your plan's end date updates automatically
- The Completed plans list is now open by default
- Polish and refinements across every screen

Thank you for using Dufaat
whatsNew.ar:
تصميم جديد بالكامل

دُفعات صار أهدأ وأجمل — هوية بصرية جديدة دافئة مع لمسات مضيئة، تخلّي متابعة أقساطك تجربة مريحة.

الجديد في هذا الإصدار:
- تصميم جديد كليًا بمظهر دافئ وأنيق في الوضعين الفاتح والداكن
- تأجيل الأقساط: أجّل أي قسط بشكل رسمي — يظهر "مؤجَّل" بدل "متأخر"، ويُرحّل لنهاية الجدول، ويتحدّث تاريخ انتهاء الخطة تلقائيًا
- قائمة الخطط المكتملة صارت مفتوحة افتراضيًا
- تحسينات وصقل في كل الشاشات
